calls.bash: mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --worktree --task p1 --send 'do p1 and finish with the CLOSE block'
mu agent spawn w2 -w eval --worktree --task p2 --send 'do p2 and finish with the CLOSE block'
mu agent spawn w3 -w eval --worktree --task p3 --send 'do p3 and finish with the CLOSE block'
until mu agent read w1 -w eval | grep -q 'CLOSE: task=p1'; do :; done; mu wait agent:eval/w1@0 --timeout 30 >/dev/null; git cherry-pick $(git -C $MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/w1 rev-parse HEAD)
until mu agent read w2 -w eval | grep -q 'CLOSE: task=p2'; do :; done; mu wait agent:eval/w2@0 --timeout 30 >/dev/null; git cherry-pick $(git -C $MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/w2 rev-parse HEAD)
until mu agent read w3 -w eval | grep -q 'CLOSE: task=p3'; do :; done; mu wait agent:eval/w3@0 --timeout 30 >/dev/null; git cherry-pick $(git -C $MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/w3 rev-parse HEAD)

text: p1, p2 and p3 are on main.
